verdict: Maybe, for a founder with science credibility. Decode Age pitched longevity supplements on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal, with strong revenue. Healthy-ageing products are growing among affluent buyers, but claims are heavily regulated and buyers are sceptical.
angle: Buyers in their 30s to 60s want to stay healthy for longer and read about longevity research online. Products need a strong scientific story, careful claims within FSSAI rules and lab-tested quality. Doctors and science-led content are key channels.
